entries.f03beecd21668db2: A business that guarantees the payment of rent and other charges by tenants of rental properties to landlords, and it is the company's single segment. The company enters into a rental guarantee entrustment contract with tenants and a rental guarantee contract with landlords, and if a tenant fails to pay rent and other charges, it acts as joint guarantor, pays the landlord on the tenant's behalf, and later seeks reimbursement from the tenant to recover the amount paid. As of the end of March 2026, the cumulative number of locations of partner companies, such as property management companies and real estate agencies that handle contract administration, reached 58,524. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥26,188 million.

entries.fcfef715e5f9e715: ZENHOREN was founded in Naha City, Okinawa Prefecture in 2001, and operates at 19 bases nationwide, centered on its Okinawa head office and Tokyo head office. In April 2025 it became a consolidated subsidiary of Mitsubishi UFJ Financial Group, and the number of employees for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was 575.
